acceptance_defined: 2026-11-04 before PyCy candidate implementation or numerical comparison
known_difference: Same finite 50-cell symmetric RLCG T ladder and zero storage initial state. Reference solver is independently refined before candidate comparison; PyCy uses trapezoidal integration at 10 ps. This is a lumped T-ladder validation, not Bergeron, a pi ladder, or an exact distributed cable. The official plot's S2.T_5.p2.v is boundary 15, not 25; true boundary 25 is S3.T_5.p2.v. No time, phase, amplitude or propagation-delay fitting.

internal_acceptance.independent_solution: 101 physical states (51 combined RL currents plus 50 shunt capacitor voltages), augmented by fixed 200 MHz sine/cosine; matrix-exponential response from zero physical state, independent of MNA stamps
internal_acceptance.reference_self_refinement: 10 ps and 5 ps maximum-step native runs must differ by less than one tenth of each waveform absolute error limit, with RelTol 1e-8 and AbsTol 1e-10
required_checks: zero initial capacitor voltage and inductor current
stored energy plus integrated resistive loss versus source work
exact finite-ladder response rather than a 25 ns pure-delay approximation
